title: M5 Pilobol.us onto S3 projection (pre-production)
description:
## Outcome
pilobol.us is served from its S3 projection bucket through the existing papyrus-edge-pilobol-us distribution; publishing an edit updates the live site in seconds; the Amplify reader dpdg1mg84dlwb is no longer used.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md section 9 (Migration, Pilobol.us).

## Checklist
- [ ] Pilobol.us site config: backend.publication.kind = "s3-projection"; deploy CMS backend (create-only for the new resources)
- [ ] renditions --all; project-all into the bucket
- [ ] Parity: projected bucket vs today's reader output from the same export (byte-identical) and vs live (capture.py compare)
- [ ] Swap the reader origin on papyrus-edge-pilobol-us to the bucket (OAC) and attach the function; rollback = swap back
- [ ] Remove PAPYRUS_READER_AMPLIFY_APP_ID; time Save -> Live for a test edit
- [ ] Hand the reader app to Ryan for deletion

## Acceptance
- curl https://pilobol.us/ and every sitemap URL: 200, same content-type, HTML sha256 equal to the projected bucket objects.
- A test edit in newsroom.pilobol.us is visible on pilobol.us within 60 s; mutation response has live:true.

## Out of scope
Anth.us; deleting the reader app (Ryan).

## Dependencies
Blocked by M1, M2, M3, M4.

## Risk
Low (pre-production; move fast, brief downtime acceptable).

## Estimate
3-5 agent-hours.

comments.author: home
comments.text: M5 evidence (agent). Pilobol.us PRs: #64 (projector web/projector.py, s3-projection config, next.48, media originals; merged db86b4f), #65 (drop Amplify reader id; open for merge). Papyrus #197 (media originals in renditions Lambda, in next.48). Parity: full-tree diff of old-library reader build vs project --all is empty (94 files); live 65-path check after the switch: all statuses equal, 41 byte-identical, HTML differs only by the cache-bust token (media not in the token on the Lambda path); content-type differs by charset and sitemap application/xml vs text/xml; /articles now 200 not 301. Edge stack papyrus-edge-pilobol-us changed via change set (only ReaderDistribution origin/OAC/function/error responses + new OAC; template /Users/home/Projects/edge-cloudfront/pilobol-us.yaml, not in git). Publish test through the real content-actions Lambda: page live in 9.8 s (about 8 s of it Amplify reader rebuild retries, removed by #65), unpublish gone in 8.2 s; Item/PublishedItem counts 21/18 before and after. Media upload test: object under media/ visible at pilobol.us in about 2 s. Issues for M7/M10: cache-bust token excludes media; edge template outside git; cache policy changed to CachingOptimized for the reader; legacy CMS app dv0pdx67fk80m config loses its reader trigger; AGENTS.md/README in Pilobol.us still describe the Amplify reader.
